instruction: Request bindings always validate with the package-level `binding.Validator`, so a caller cannot choose another validator per call. Make the validator explicit: add a third, required parameter `v StructValidator` to the `Bind` method of the `binding.Binding` interface (binding/binding.go and its `nomsgpack` twin binding/binding_nomsgpack.go), so it becomes `Bind(req *http.Request, obj any, v StructValidator) error`. Change every implementation (jsonBinding, xmlBinding, formBinding, formPostBinding, formMultipartBinding, queryBinding, headerBinding, plainBinding, protobufBinding, msgpackBinding, yamlBinding, tomlBinding, bsonBinding, and any implementation in tests) and every call of `Binding.Bind`, in source and in tests (including tests built only with the `nomsgpack` tag). Every existing call must pass the package-level validator, so behavior does not change: `binding.Validator` outside package binding (e.g. `Context.ShouldBindWith`), `Validator` inside it. Implementations do not have to use the new parameter yet. Do not add a two-argument variant. Do not change `Context.Bind(obj)`, the `gin.Bind` helper, `BindingBody.BindBody`, `BindingUri.BindUri` or any other `Bind*` method.
gold_tool: build_deep.py go recipe: declarations by pattern (func (recv) Bind(req *http.Request, obj any) and the interface lines), call sites from go build/go test compile errors (-gcflags=-e, default tags and -tags nomsgpack), iterated to a clean build; gofmt (go1.25.14 GOTOOLCHAIN=local)
change: add required parameter (interface method: 13 implementations + callers, two build-tag variants)
